# Xoroh Atlas

> Reusable documentation platform for the Xoroh ecosystem. This index is a
> static starting point; a generated manifest follows when versioned
> documentation exists.

## Sites

- / — Introduction: what Atlas is and is not.
- /getting-started/ — install, develop, validate.
- /guides/contributing/ — contribution rules.
- /guides/governance/ — maintenance and decisions.
- /guides/architecture/ — engine/site boundary and content model.

## Source

Canonical content lives in `apps/docs/src/content/docs/` of
https://github.com/xoroh/atlas (`development` branch until release).
